verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own docs show the key working across several operating systems: Windows login, Linux PAM and Android. They also name example services such as Google, Facebook, Office 365, Nextcloud and Entra ID. However, the pack contains no published compatibility catalog of supported services and nothing on browser support. missing for 10: a published service compatibility catalog/list, browser compatibility documentation, macOS coverage, independent hands-on cross-platform corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works across my operating systems and browsers, with a published compatibility catalog of supported services

citations.quote: Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
